correctness.rationale: After affine normalization, the two free recurrence coefficients are \(1+x\) and \(1+y\) with \(x,y>0\). Exact substitution gives \(P_4=(-1-x,1+x)\) and \(P_5=(-x-y-xy,x+xy)\). In the published completion geometry, \(B=P_3\), while the parameters of \(A\) and \(O\) along \(P_1P_5\) are \(1/[x(1+y)]\) and \((xy+y-1)/[y(x+1)]\). Their difference factors with the sign of \(xy-1\). This proves necessity, and case (0) of the published hyperbola construction gives a unique convex completion for every \(xy>1\). Smoothness and the logarithmic half-plane model then give the diffeomorphism and contractibility. No experiment substitutes for proof.

value.rationale: The result resolves the first genuinely two-dimensional case of an explicitly published connectedness conjecture for affine moduli of convex equal-area polygons. It gives more than connectedness: an exact global coordinate domain and contractibility. The subclass is not arbitrary; \(n=7\) is the first case where the moduli dimension \(n-5\) equals two, so the topology is not forced by a one-parameter interval argument.
